experiments.procedure_text: Hind-paw mechanical, cold and heat responses and rotarod motor performance were assessed using the reported behavioural test methods.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Fifty percent mechanical threshold was measured with calibrated von Frey filaments

endpoints.evidence: Allodynia was scored as a percentage of brisk withdrawals out of six trials

endpoints.label: Pinprick response percentage
endpoints.evidence: Paw withdrawal, shaking, or licking was scored as a response

endpoints.label: Latency to respond to blunt pressure from an alligator clip
endpoints.evidence: The time to respond was recorded and reported as latency for each mouse.

endpoints.label: Heat sensitivity threshold by mean Hargreaves withdrawal latency

experiments.regulatory_evidence: Reporting of In vivo Experiments (ARRIVE) guidelines
experiments.notes: Shared methods do not establish a separate cohort: von Frey used 30-60 min acclimation and a 1-second withdrawal criterion, brush six trials, and nonpenetrating 27-gauge pinprick 1 hour acclimation and ten trials at 1-min intervals with a new needle per mouse. Clip used 5 min acclimation and a 90 s cut-off; dry ice used 20 minutes acclimation and 3/16-inch glass; cold and heat each used three trials at 5-min intervals, heat a 20 s cut-off, and rotarod 0.2 rpm/sec over two minutes.
